description: German day-ahead prices of 2024 (Energy-Charts, DE-LU) as a dynamic household tariff, per kWh, one price per hourly market step from 00:00. Each day of 2016 takes the 2024 day 2926 days later, the same weekday. With s = max(spot, 0): utility = s + 0.3163 (DESTATIS 2024 household price 0.3948 minus the mean spot), feed-in = a flat 0.08. 'utility' and 'feed_in' at the top are the mean day; 'days' is what the market trades at. Built by build_de_2024.py.
